mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses the risk-free rate, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market health, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) below their 12-month moving averages indicate broad economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days through reduced revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and INDPRO both below 12-month moving averages
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and INDPRO are below their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL year-over-year inflation exceeding 2.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) year-over-year growth exceeding 10% indicates strong consumer confidence and residential investment, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST YoY change exceeds 10%.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) year-over-year decline exceeding 0.5% signals labor market contraction, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS YoY change is below -0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) declining below its 6-month moving average for three consecutive months indicates manufacturing sector weakness, reducing corporate earnings growth and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO remains below its 6-month moving average for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer credit growth (RSAFS) year-over-year exceeding 5% indicates strong household spending power, driving higher corporate revenues and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS YoY change exceeds 5%.
